notes: SqueekToken is a fixed-supply ERC-20 named Squeek (SQK) with 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints all 1,000,000,000 SQK once to msg.sender, the factory at launch. It has no owner, additional minting, burning, transfer fees, pause or blocklist. No application contracts are deployed. The pool pairs SQK with IMD. initialPrice records provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and totalSupply.
